title: Soveraeign Recording
description: PROPOSED ahead of O10 (SPEC.md owner freeze pending). Compiles the SPEC.md Recording object: the output of read_source, which resolves its exact source, reader version, configuration, fidelity, and recoverable omissions. A recording never replaces or mutates its source. The Reader declaration is embedded (reader_id, reader_version, configuration_digest, fidelity, omissions) rather than referenced, so no separate Reader schema is required.

recording_id.description: Identity of this recording. Distinct from its payload address and digest.

source_id.description: Identity of the Source that was read.

source_digest.description: Digest of the source bytes at the moment of reading. Must equal the Source payload_digest; a mismatch is the SOURCE_CHANGED refusal of read_source.

reader_id.description: Identity of the declared Reader. An undeclared reader is the READER_UNDECLARED refusal of read_source.

reader_version.description: Exact version of the reader that produced this recording.

configuration_digest.description: Digest of the reader configuration in force for this reading.

payload_address.description: Address where the recording bytes resolve. An address is an identity role distinct from a digest, so no digest pattern is imposed.

payload_digest.description: Digest of the recording bytes resolved by payload_address.

fidelity.description: EXACT readers declare no omissions; LOSSY readers must declare at least one versioned omission definition.

omissions.description: Versioned omission definitions from which the omitted content is deterministically recoverable. Empty for EXACT fidelity.

definition_id.description: Versioned omission definition identifier, for example body-text-only-v1.

definition_digest.description: Digest of the omission definition content at that version.

produced_at.description: When the recording was produced, RFC 3339 with an explicit offset.

produced_by.description: Attributable identity of the actor that ran read_source. Never a credential.

standing.description: Record standing per CLASSIFICATION.md, not the artifact lifecycle.
